review_evidence: The unit has 88 primary Rocq files; 77 contain 5,691 theorem/lemma/definition/instance/notation/tactic-family declarations under a broad declaration scan.
std++ is an extended Rocq standard library supplying reusable definitions and lemmas for collections, algebraic structures, finite/countable types, relations, bitvectors, and proof automation.

Declaration-light primary modules are re-export, options/ssreflect compatibility, notation, tactic, or checked test modules rather than disposable build residue; no lossless hard-exclusion selector was established.
summary: Retain the complete std++ Rocq formal-source unit, including its reusable library, tactics, compatibility layers, and checked regression material.
